Phase 5 mid-execution amendment: algo2code parser bugs that originally deferred direct emission landed in the same phase under this task's umbrella. Multi-letter scratch identifiers (sy, Hp, ap, alpha_new) and binary `/` in expressions both work. If/Else guard on `ap < tol` handles the alpha_old=0 + n<1 boundary (matches imported's yield_stress_derivative regularisation threshold).

packages/algo2code/src/algo2code/library/radial_return_j2.py exposes RADIAL_RETURN_J2_LATEX, get_radial_return_j2_latex(), and transpile_radial_return_j2(backend) — the latter is consumed by mechdsl.lib.plasticity at module-load.
